200 index point intervals

The Exchange will list At-the-Money (ATM) strike put and call options and the next 30 exercise prices above and below the ATM strike.

No new options shall be listed, however, if there are less than three calendar days remaining to the Expiration Day of the Option Contract.
data.optionExercise:
European Style: An option may be exercised by the buyer only at expiry.

Exercise results in a long SGX FTSE China H50 Index futures position, which corresponds with the option's contract month, for a call buyer or a put seller, and a short SGX FTSE China H50 Index futures position for a put buyer and a call seller.

An option that is in-the-money and has not been liquidated or exercised prior to the termination of trading shall be exercised automatically.

data.strikePriceIntervals:
Strike price intervals of 0.50 US cents per 100 Rupees.

The Exchange will list At-the-Money (ATM) strike put and call options and the next twelve exercise prices above and below the ATM strike. ATM strike refers to the exercise price nearest to the last available Spot Exchange Rate  when the Exchange lists such exercise price, save that where there are two such exercise prices, the ATM strike means the lower of these two prices.

Spot Exchange Rate means the reciprocal of the spot exchange rate for Indian rupees per United States dollar published by the Reserve Bank of India, or such publicly available equivalent successor rate that is determined by SGX-DT, multiplied by 10,000 to convert such spot exchange rate to United States cents per 100 Indian rupees, and the result rounded to two decimal places.
data.optionExercise:
European style. Automatic exercise of the in-the-money options.

Exercise results in a long SGX INR/USD FX Futures position, which corresponds with the option’s contract month for a call buyer or a put seller, and a short SGX INR/USD FX Futures position for a put buyer or a call seller.

contractDetails.processed:
Ticker Symbol

SNDddmmyy, where ddmmyy:

1) Is any Business Day within 100 calendar days (inclusive of day of trade registration); and
2) Cannot be a non-clearing day at SGX-DC (e.g. Saturdays, Sundays, 1 Jan, or 2 Jan if 1 Jan falls on a Sunday); and
3) Is not the Last Trading Day of the standard FX Futures of the same underlying currency pair.

*SGX FlexC FX Futures with a tenor of up to 38 calendar days will be listed for screen trading. Notwithstanding this, participants can register off-exchange SGX FlexC FX Futures trades with a tenor of up to 100 calendar days for clearing at SGX. Should an off-exchange SGX FlexC FX Futures with a tenor of between 39 and 100 calendar days be registered for clearing at SGX, such a Futures series will also be available for screen trading.

See Last Trading Day.

^For details about screen-traded FlexC futures, refer to the Full Legal Contract Specs for SGX FlexC USD/SGD (Full-sized) Futures. For off-screen traded FlexC Futures, refer to the Full Legal Contract Specs for SGX USD/SGD (Full-sized) Futures.

Strike price shall be stated in terms of the SGX MSCI Singapore Index futures contract which is deliverable upon exercise of the Option and shall be an integer divisible by five (5) without reminder e.g 340, 345, 350, 355, etc.
The Exchange will list At-the-Money (ATM) strike call and put options and the next eight eligible exercise prices above and below the ATM strike. ATM strike refers to the exercise price nearest to the previous day’s Daily Settlement Price of the underlying SGX MSCI Singapore Index futures.
For new contract month, ATM strike will refer to the exercise price nearest to the previous day’s Daily Settlement Price of the Spot Month Futures Contract.
No new options shall be listed, however, if there are less than three calendar days remaining to the Expiration Day of the Options.

contractDetails.processed:
Accumulated Dividend: 

Cumulative value of the final official closing values of each relevant yearly series of the Nikkei Stock Average Dividend Point Index and the official closing value of the Nikkei Stock Average Estimated Dividend Point Index, subtracting the value of the Nikkei Stock Average Estimated Dividend Point Index as of the Contract Business Day immediately preceding the Product Launch Date and adjusting for differences between any of the underlying constituent stocks estimated dividends included with ex-dividend date prior to the Product Launch Date and paid-in dividends that was paid out on or after Launch Date, and subtracting dividends arising from ex-dividend dates after the Special Quotation Date. This value represents the accumulated dividends which an investor would have been entitled to receive if the investor had held the constituents stocks of the Nikkei Stock Average between the Product Launch Date till the Special Quotation Date. The Product Launch Date is 13 May 2019.

 

Accumulated Funding: 

Cumulative value of Daily Funding over the whole period commencing on the Launch Date till the Contract Business Day immediately succeeding the Last Trading Day of the Nikkei 225 Index Futures for the contract month with the same contract year, inclusive of start and end dates.

 

Daily Funding: 

The value represented by the product of (i) the official close of the Nikkei Stock Average on the Contract Business Day immediately preceding the trading day; (ii) the Daily Funding Rate on the Contract Business Day immediately preceding the trading day divided by 100; and (iii) the number of funding days over an annualisation factor of 360.

The number of funding days is the difference in number of calendar days between (i) the trading day plus the requisite number of days for settlement within the Japanese securities settlement cycle; and (ii) the Contract business day immediately preceding the trading day plus the requisite number of days for settlement within the Japanese securities settlement cycle, except for when the trading day is not a Contract Business Day the number of funding days is zero.

 

Special Quotation Date: 

The relevant Contract Business Day immediately succeeding the Last Trading Day of the relevant Nikkei Stock Average Futures for the contract month with the same contract year as the Contract.

If the said Wednesday falls on a Singapore public holiday, the Last Trading Day shall be the Trading Day preceding the following Business Day of such Wednesday.
data.finalSettlementPrice:
100 minus the annualised rate (R) (R is rounded to 4 decimal places), which is calculated by multiplying the interest rate calculated by daily cumulative compounding of SORA in the Interest Rate Reference Period for the relevant contract month by (365 / actual number of calendar days in the Interest Rate Reference Period).

Note: For each non-Business Day, the SORA value for the preceding Business Day will apply without compounding.

Interest Rate Reference Period: From the third Wednesday of each contract month (March, June, September, December) to the Tuesday preceding the third Wednesday of the subsequent quarter (beginning in June, September, December, March). The Interest Rate Reference Period will not be moved up or down even if the start or end date is a non-Business Day.
